label: ACCEPT
reason: The published package depends on nothing in benches (benches depends on @pmndrs/glyph); the only outlier, react-browser-check.mts, reaches four levels up into benches/scripts/support/project-chromium.mts to borrow its playwright launcher, which check-peer-versions.mts props up by symlinking benches into the temp consumer. label: WRONG
reason: The package uses TypeError/RangeError for malformed caller input (text-properties.ts assert*/normalize*) and bare Error for state and environment failures: 'is disposed' (typegpu/text.ts), 'already installed'/'not installed' (raster-codec-registry.ts), 'coordinator is unavailable' (three/glyphs.ts, decorations.ts), 'lease underflow' (loaded-font.ts), HTTP and rollback failures; 228 bare Error throws exist in src, and the example defineRasterBaker throws nothing at all. New functions with a state failure would be flagged for nothing; only createFontFace's duplicate family and raster-ktx's missing identifier look off-scheme (2 of 19). No oxlint rule covers this.
